title: Duplicate billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = Duplicate (ebilling-r1 task 070; spec FR-24, design.md 6.1). 9. The firm invoice number was not already submitted by the firm, and no line duplicates an earlier line on the match fields. The outcome (Reject or finding) is the policy version's consequence, never hard-coded (D-88). Parameters only: no rates, timekeepers or code descriptions, and no consequence (that is the sprk_consequence column). additionalProperties=false: any other member is refused, not ignored. 'messageTemplate' (anywhere) and 'then' are refused by RuleBodySchemaValidator before this schema runs.

matchFields.description: The fields compared. firmInvoiceNumber compares invoices; the others compare lines.
